CS80 0.2.0 for Linux (64-bit VST3, x86_64)

Copy the CS80.vst3 folder to ~/.vst3/ (or /usr/lib/vst3/ for all users),
then rescan plug-ins in your DAW (Reaper, Bitwig, Ardour). It is listed as
leblancfg > CS80.

The faceplate needs WebKitGTK 4.1 (libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 on Debian and Ubuntu,
webkit2gtk4.1 on Fedora).

Source and notes: https://github.com/leblancfg/cs80
